msg: Control flow of non-void function ends here!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6252547b8a7.c (Linux TWL4030). 'Control flow of non-void function ends here!' at lines 25-26, when def(CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE). twl_probe() is declared as 'int' (line 17) but has no return statement — simplification artifact (real Linux twl_probe returns an error code from device registration). The known vbdb bug for this file is the NULLPTR_DEREFERENCE on ops at line 25 when TWL4030_CORE=true and OF_IRQ=false (ops stays NULL); the missing return is a separate artifact of simplification.
